questions.question: Arrange the following words in the order in which they appear in an English dictionary. 1. General 2. Gender 3. Gasket 4. Genial 5. Gather
questions.questionHtml:
Arrange the following words in the order in which they appear in an English dictionary.

1. General

2. Gender

3. Gasket

4. Genial

5. Gather
questions.solution:
Gasket comes first in the order.

It is followed by Gather.

Gather is followed by Gender.

Gender is followed by General.

General is followed by Genial.

The correct dictionary order is,

Gasket (3) → Gather (5) → Gender (2) → General (1) → Genial (4)

Hence, option 4 is the correct answer.
